title: Introduction to Analyzing FASTA Files
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qg6dtze

steps.title: Create working directory
steps.instruction: Make a new folder for the analysis and move into it.

substeps.instruction: ls   # optional, to confirm the directory is empty

steps.title: Download and unzip genome FASTA
steps.instruction: Retrieve the compressed Y. pestis genome file and decompress it.

substeps.instruction: ls   # optional, to verify y_pestis_genome.fna is present

steps.title: Inspect genome file
steps.instruction: View the first and last lines of the genome FASTA to confirm format.

steps.title: Count genome sequences
steps.instruction: Determine how many distinct sequences (contigs) are in the genome file.

steps.title: Download and unzip genes FASTA
steps.instruction: Retrieve the compressed coding‑sequence file and decompress it.

substeps.instruction: ls   # optional, to see both genome and gene files

steps.title: Inspect genes file
steps.instruction: Look at the beginning of the genes FASTA and count the entries.

steps.title: Install seqtk tool
steps.instruction: Add the seqtk utility to the system and list its commands.

steps.title: Compute genome composition
steps.instruction: Run seqtk’s comp utility on the genome FASTA to obtain length and nucleotide counts.

steps.title: Compute gene statistics
steps.instruction: Run seqtk comp on the genes file and show only the first few lines.

steps.title: Find longest gene
steps.instruction: Identify the longest coding sequence and retrieve its header.

steps.title: Count chromosome genes
steps.instruction: Count how many gene entries belong to the main chromosome (NC_003143.1).

steps.title: Search for specific functions
steps.instruction: Count genes whose descriptions contain particular keywords.

steps.title: Install datamash tool
steps.instruction: Add the datamash utility for simple statistical calculations.

steps.title: Calculate mean gene length
steps.instruction: Compute the average length of all genes and of chromosome‑only genes.

substeps.instruction: seqtk comp y_pestis_genes.fna | grep "NC_003143.1" | datamash mean 2

steps.title: Calculate total coding length
steps.instruction: Sum the lengths of all protein‑coding genes on the main chromosome.

substeps.instruction: seqtk comp y_pestis_genes.fna | grep "NC_003143.1" | datamash sum 2
